comparisons.peer_summary: Acquisition-related intangible amortization expense was $2.4 billion and $2.8 billion in fiscal years 2024 and 2023, respectively.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVIDIA and AMD disclose acquisition-related expenses for intangible assets, though they present different metrics: NVIDIA reports the gross value of assets acquired via assumed liabilities ($170 million), while AMD reports the periodic amortization expense of acquired intangibles ($2.4 billion). Both items relate to the financial impact of past acquisitions on the balance sheet and income statement.

peer_results.rationale: None of the retrieved candidates (Depreciation Expense, Net Revenue by Major Country) are substantively comparable to the target's topic of asset acquisitions via assumed liabilities. Depreciation is an operating expense allocation, and revenue geography is a top-line metric, neither of which addresses the mechanics or volume of acquisition-related asset/liability assumptions.

comparisons.peer_topic: Business Combinations Accounting Policy and Fair Value Allocation
comparisons.peer_summary: Intel allocates purchase prices for acquisitions based on estimated fair values, involving assumptions and judgments for inventory, property, intangible assets, deferred taxes, and goodwill. Adjustments to these values may be recognized during a measurement period of up to one year from the acquisition date, based on comparable market data and management information.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVIDIA and Intel disclose details regarding business combinations and asset acquisitions. NVIDIA quantifies the value of property, equipment, and intangible assets acquired by assuming related liabilities ($170 million in 2024). Similarly, Intel describes its accounting policy for allocating purchase prices for assets acquired and liabilities assumed based on estimated fair values, specifically mentioning the valuation of property and intangible assets, although it does not provide a comparable aggregate transaction volume figure for the period.

sentences.text: Property, equipment and intangible assets acquired by assuming related liabilities during fiscal years 2024, 2023, and 2022 were $170 million, $374 million, and $258 million, respectively.
We allocate the purchase price paid for assets acquired and liabilities assumed in connection with our acquisitions based on their estimated fair values at the time of acquisition.
